tranches.name: protocol-provider-stability
tranches.exit: available model/arm strata have complete records; blocked strata have readiness evidence

tranches.name: local-sut-admission
tranches.exit: reset, oracle, fault, evolution, and three-arm pilot gates pass

tranches.name: candidate-wave-expansion
tranches.exit: each candidate is admitted, rejected, or parked with evidence

tranches.name: model-framework-replication
tranches.exit: adapter conformance and replay-equivalence gates pass

tranches.name: cross-application-workflows
tranches.exit: both endpoints and handoff oracle independently admitted

tranches.name: variance-power-confirmatory-freeze
tranches.exit: pilot variance, power, concurrency, and analysis hashes frozen

branch_policy.provider_block: retain provider-api record; exclude from capability pooling; backfill exact cell after reactivation
branch_policy.visual_instability: classify provider-format, grounding, termination, budget, and sut boundaries before redesign
branch_policy.application_failure: park candidate and advance queue; never fill target with repeated admitted applications
branch_policy.power_infeasible: reduce pre-specified interaction scope rather than run underpowered universal comparison

non_substitution_rules: Blueprint workflows are not experimental records.
Provider connectivity and framework smoke are not cell passes.
Pilot and confirmatory denominators never mix.
Model and framework replication strata are not silently pooled with primary arm effects.
